rule: DGCA refund rule. The rule gives no start day; Refund Genie counts from your cancellation date (Refund Genie's reading). About 14 working days, Monday to Friday; holidays ignored.

action: Mail Nodal Officer at IndiGo: nodalofficer@goindigo.in. The airline owes the refund; ask for its status and reference.

rule: You booked direct and cancelled within the look-in window: no cancellation charge under DGCA paragraph 3(e). Taxes and airport fees are always refunded, even on non-refundable and promo fares and no-shows.
